messages:
Maria H.: Quick check — post-launch funnel for the Feature X campaign. Top-of-funnel traffic and webinar signups are on target, but MQL -> SQL conversion dropped from 18% last week to 9% this week :thinking: Anyone see routing or quality changes?
Ben G.: Link to the funnel dashboard? want to pull segments. :eyes:
Maria H.: dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/launch-funnel — add segment=webinar
Oliver D.: quick numbers from Looker: total leads = 1,240 (wk), MQL=480, SQL=43. conversion MQL->SQL = 8.9%. W-o-W MQL -12%, SQL -38%.
Priya S.: we flipped the inbound routing rule on Wed to send webinar leads to SDR queue B instead of A for capacity reasons. that could affect pickup times.
Samira (Growth): pickup times matter — SDR B's avg first touch = 42h vs SDR A 10h. slow nurture explains SQL drop.
Ben G.: can we get breakdown by source + routing? Oliver?
Oliver D.: ran quick SQL:
```
SELECT source, routing_queue, COUNT(*) as leads
FROM leads
WHERE campaign='feature_x' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-08' AND '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY leads DESC;
```
Oliver D.: results: webinar: routing=SDR_B leads=560; webinar:SDR_A leads=180; organic:SDR_A=300; paid:SDR_B=200
Maria H.: oh — looks like majority of webinar leads went to SDR_B. that's the issue. any idea why?
Priya S.: rule was a temporary overflow. should we revert? pros: faster pickup. cons: capacity spike on SDR_A.
Samira (Growth): propose revert + short A/B on messaging: current post-webinar email has generic CTA. test a "book a quick call" vs "watch product clip".
Ben G.: also recommend adding a weighted attribution window for webinar leads (14d) vs paid (7d) in the dashboard to avoid noise.
Maria H.: action items: 1) Priya revert routing to SDR_A for webinar leads (if capacity ok) 2) Ben & Samira set up two nurture variants, start n=1k webinar leads 3) Oliver add routing dimension to weekly KPI board + w-o-w deltas. I'll report back on Friday. :thumbsup:
dashbot: Weekly marketing funnel report uploaded: https://redwood.app/reports/weekly-funnel-1935
Maria H.: thanks — tagging @Oliver D. @Priya S. @Samira (Growth) let's sync tomorrow 10am.
